label: Bible Study
prompt: And all that believed were together, and had all things _____;
verse: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
note: The first believers shared everything — Acts says no one among them lacked.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He brought me forth also into a _____ place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verse: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
note: God brought David out into a large place — simply because He delighted in him.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Jonathan stripped himself of the _____ that was upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.
verse: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.
note: Jonathan, heir to the throne, gave David his robe, sword, and bow — handing over the prince's things to his friend.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Thou shalt rise up before the _____ head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.
verse: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.
note: 'Hoary' means white-haired — the Law told Israel to stand up when the elderly entered the room.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is _____.
verse: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
note: Psalm 145, titled 'David's Psalm of praise,' calls God's greatness 'unsearchable' — a well with no bottom.
